# `fnox plugin`

- **Usage:** `fnox plugin [SUBCOMMAND]`

Manage Lua provider plugins

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`fnox plugin link [-f --force] <NAME> <PATH>`](/cli/plugin/link.md)
- [`fnox plugin ls`](/cli/plugin/ls.md)
- [`fnox plugin uninstall <NAME>`](/cli/plugin/uninstall.md)
- [`fnox plugin update [NAMES]…`](/cli/plugin/update.md)

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Manage Lua provider plugins. Without a subcommand, lists installed plugins and plugins declared under [plugins] that are not installed yet.

```sh
fnox plugin
fnox plugin install
```
